bio:
PORTAL

*Monthly* 

* Born of the diaspora, PORTAL opens through music and dance to connect with our spirit and lineage — sound and movement as memory, memory as movement and sound. A conscious collective, forged in curiosity, shaped by a desire to reimagine what community can be. Deconstructing and rebuilding our spaces, our sounds, our identities, carrying the knowledge forward. For us, dance is not simply joy nor a fleeting moment of release. It is resistance. A weapon, if you will.
title: PORTAL
